title.rendered: Jack&Jones Alfred File Case Pro Bag

content.rendered:
The Jack&Jones Alfred File Case Pro is designed for modern professionals who value style, durability, and efficiency. Built with 100% PU Leather and fitted with a high-quality YKK Zipper, this 10-liter laptop and file organizer bag combines luxury with performance. Whether you’re commuting to the office, traveling for business, or attending meetings, this premium laptop bag offers the ideal balance of storage, comfort, and long-lasting reliability.

With a dedicated padded compartment that ensures smooth 15 Inch Laptop compatibility, the is perfect for executives, students, corporate employees, and entrepreneurs. The smart Twin Grip Handle allows comfortable portability, while the Adjustable & Detachable Shoulder Straps help you carry the bag in multiple ways. Its integrated Luggage Sleeve makes it travel-friendly, giving you a hassle-free airport and transit experience.

Engineered using high-grade materials, this PU leather laptop resists everyday wear and maintains a premium look. The spacious 10 Lts capacity provides organized storage for documents, chargers, gadgets, business files, diaries, and daily essentials. The use of a branded YKK zipper ensures long-lasting smooth operation, preventing snagging and ensuring secure closure during daily use.

Key Features

  • Model: Alfred File Case Pro
  • Capacity: 10 Lts – Lightweight yet spacious file and laptop
  • Material: 100% Premium PU Leather
  • Zipper: Smooth & durable YKK Zipper
  • Handles: Twin Grip Handle for easy hand-carry
  • Straps: Adjustable & Detachable Shoulder Straps
  • Luggage Sleeve: Built-in sleeve for trolley bags
  • Laptop Compatibility: Fits up to a 15 Inch Laptop
  • Use Case: Office, corporate travel, meetings, business, daily commute
